content_sections.heading: HBCHRC MTS Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease depending on the requirements of the centre.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed SSC and should possess at least one year of relevant work experience. Candidates with housekeeping experience in a hospital will be preferred. The prescribed age limit for the Multi-Tasking Staff post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be provided to exceptional candidates based on the recommendation of the selection committee.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC MTS Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,020 per month .

content_sections.heading: Contract Period
content_sections.text: The appointment will initially be for a fixed period of six months from the date of joining. The tenure may be extended depending on the requirement. The post is purely temporary.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through a walk-in interview. Applicants must report at the interview venue between 9:30 AM and 10:30 AM on 25 September 2026 with the required documents.

content_sections.heading: Walk-in Interview Venue
content_sections.text: HRD Department, First Floor Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Aganampudi, Visakhapatnam

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for the Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates should bring the following documents to the walk-in interview: Updated resume Recent passport-size photograph PAN Card photocopy Aadhaar Card photocopy Original educational certificates Original experience and relieving certificates Last three months’ salary slips One set of self-attested photocopies of all certificates Additional employment proof, if required Candidates who fail to bring the required original certificates and photocopies will not be permitted to attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Attend HBCHRC MTS Walk-in Interview 2026
content_sections.text: Check the eligibility requirements given in the notification. Prepare an updated resume and collect all required certificates. Bring the original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies. Report to the HRD Department, First Floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam. Reach the venue between 9:30 AM and 10:30 AM on 25 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The advertised positions are purely temporary. The selected candidates must be willing to work in shifts. Shift duties may include nights, Sundays and holidays. The number of posts may change according to the centre’s requirements. Candidates must produce all original certificates at the interview. Applicants should carry proof of their educational qualifications and work experience.
